faq.title: Questions candidates often ask
faq.guaranteeQuestion: Does applying guarantee a job or visa?
faq.guaranteeAnswer: No. An application is only a request to be considered. Shortlisting, employment and visa approval are decided by the relevant authorized parties.
faq.verifiedQuestion: What does a published vacancy mean?
faq.verifiedAnswer: Published vacancies have passed the site's verification workflow. Availability and details may still change, so review the reference and confirm important terms before making decisions.
faq.documentsQuestion: Should I send passport or medical documents with my first application?
faq.documentsAnswer: No. The initial application does not request passport scans, medical records or other highly sensitive documents. Do not send them through unverified channels.
faq.feesQuestion: Should I pay a fee to secure an opportunity?
faq.feesAnswer: Do not pay unexpected fees or anyone promising a guaranteed outcome. Any applicable fee must be transparently disclosed and confirmed as lawful through the authorized recruitment arrangement.

about.title: About GulfBridge Overseas
about.body: GulfBridge Overseas is building a transparent way for candidates to explore overseas opportunities. Recruitment services are provided only through legally authorized arrangements and applicable procedures.
process.title: How it works
process.intro: Understand the steps before sharing your information or making a decision.
process.step1: Explore published vacancies and review the employer-confirmed details.
process.step2: Submit a focused application and read the privacy notice before giving consent.
process.step3: Our team reviews applications and may contact suitable candidates about next steps.
process.step4: Any interview, offer, contract and visa process must be confirmed through the authorized parties.
safety.title: Your safety matters
safety.body: Take time to verify every opportunity. Do not pay unexpected fees or share sensitive documents through unverified channels.
safety.alertBody: Verify any recruitment fee request with the legally authorized recruitment partner and applicable official guidance before paying.
safety.tip1: Check the vacancy reference, employer details and verification status.
safety.tip2: Be cautious of guaranteed job offers, visa promises or pressure to pay immediately.
safety.tip3: Never share passwords, one-time passcodes, bank credentials or passport scans in an initial application.
safety.tip4: Confirm recruitment arrangements with the appropriate legally authorized partner.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body: We collect the information you submit to respond to applications and enquiries. We do not request passport scans, medical records or other highly sensitive documents in the initial application. Access to submitted records is restricted to authorized administrators. Before launch, the business must add its contact details, retention period, lawful basis and deletion-request process and obtain legal review.
terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.body: Vacancies are subject to verification and availability. Applications do not guarantee selection, employment or visa approval. Recruitment services are provided only through legally authorized arrangements and applicable procedures. The business must have these terms reviewed and finalized before launch.
